name: AssertionMethod
summary: Compares what happened with what was expected and fails the test when they differ, so that a verification is a call rather than a conditional.

roles.name: AssertionMethod
roles.summary: The method a test calls to state its expectation. What it must do is fail the test rather than return a verdict — an assertion whose result the caller has to check is one a caller can forget to check, which is how a test starts passing for the wrong reason.
